fact: Loi n° 05-20 on cybersecurity (dahir n° 1-20-69 of 25 July 2020, Bulletin officiel n° 6906 of 6 August 2020) is promulgated; its article 53 makes it operative on publication of its implementing texts, and the page says décret n° 2-24-921 applying article 25 was in force by the Bulletin officiel of 20 February 2025.
